content: 1. CYP3A4 Substrates and Elagolix: When co-administered with cenobamate, increase the dose of CYP3A4 substrates as needed. Monitor therapy closely. Elagolix is a weak-to-moderate CYP3A4 inducer. Monitor CYP3A4 substrates when co-administered and consider increasing their dose if necessary. 2. Atorvastatin: Elagolix increases atorvastatin levels via P-glycoprotein (MDR1) inhibition but decreases its levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Adjust therapy and monitor closely. 3. Avanafil, Avatrombopag, Axitinib, Bedaquiline, Belumosudil: Elagolix decreases the levels of these drugs by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitor therapy closely and consider dose adjustments. 4. Belzutifan: Belzutifan decreases elagolix levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. If co-administration is unavoidable, increase the dose of sensitive CYP3A4 substrates as per prescribing guidelines. 5. Bendamustine: Elagolix increases bendamustine levels via P-glycoprotein inhibition. Use caution and monitor therapy. 6. Benzphetamine: Elagolix decreases benzphetamine levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitor therapy closely and adjust doses as needed. 7. Berotralstat: Elagolix increases berotralstat levels via P-glycoprotein inhibition. Use caution and monitor therapy. 8. Betrixaban: Elagolix increases betrixaban levels via P-glycoprotein inhibition. Use caution and monitor therapy. 9. Bexarotene: Bexarotene decreases elagolix levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor therapy. 10. Bortezomib: Elagolix increases bortezomib levels by inhibiting CYP2C19 metabolism but decreases its levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitor therapy closely and adjust doses as needed. 11. Bosentan: Bosentan decreases elagolix levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Elagolix decreases bosentan levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitor therapy closely and adjust doses as needed. 12. Monitor therapy closely and adjust doses as needed. 15. Bromocriptine: Elagolix decreases bromocriptine levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitor therapy closely and adjust doses as needed. 16. Budesonide: Elagolix increases budesonide levels via P-glycoprotein inhibition but decreases its levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitor therapy closely and adjust doses as needed. 17. Buprenorphine (Various Forms): Elagolix decreases buprenorphine levels (including buccal, subdermal implant, transdermal, and long-acting injection) by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitor therapy closely and adjust doses as needed. 18. Buspirone: Elagolix decreases buspirone levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitor therapy closely and adjust doses as needed. 19. Busulfan: Elagolix decreases busulfan levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitor therapy closely and adjust doses as needed. 20. Butabarbital and Butalbital: Both drugs decrease elagolix levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor therapy. 21. Monitor therapy closely and adjust doses as needed. 24. Carfilzomib: Elagolix increases carfilzomib levels via P-glycoprotein inhibition. Use caution and monitor therapy. 25. Carisoprodol: Elagolix increases carisoprodol levels by inhibiting CYP2C19 metabolism. Monitor therapy closely and use caution with sensitive CYP2C19 substrates. 27. Carvedilol: Elagolix increases carvedilol levels via P-glycoprotein inhibition. Use caution and monitor therapy. 28. Cenobamate: Cenobamate decreases elagolix levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Increase the dose of CYP3A4 substrates as needed when co-administered. 29.
